payload.summary: Tools and Favourites bespoke home composer slots skip the SSR height reservation chrome invariant 15 requires
payload.detail: ModeHomeTemplate renders its composer slot with data-composer-reserve='pending' plus min-h tokens (mode-home-template.tsx:316-320) so the hero does not shift when the portal attaches. The two bespoke homes hand-roll the slot without either: favourites-command-library-page.tsx:1426 and tools-search-results-page.tsx:353, plus favourites-hub.tsx:187. Those three get no SSR height reservation, which is the CLS that invariant 15 exists to prevent. Found during the PR #2160 cross-mode audit.
